name: Hatha Yoga
tagline: Asana, pranayama, meditation and embodied awareness
description: A steady, intentional Hatha practice that weaves together asana, pranayama, meditation, and embodied awareness. Moving at an easy-to-follow pace, this class includes intentional moments of pause between postures, offering space to notice, soften, and connect more deeply with the breath and with yourself. With a strong focus on alignment and breath, students are invited to build strength, cultivate balance, and move with greater presence throughout the practice. Suitable for all levels, this class is especially supportive for beginners or anyone looking for a more grounded and accessible approach to yoga.
benefits: Benefits: - Improves strength and balance through steady, alignment-focused practice - Supports nervous system regulation through breath awareness and moments of pause - cultivate presence, inner calm, and a deeper connection to self
avoid: Who should avoid the class This class is accessible to most students, including beginners. It should only be avoided by those who have been advised by a medical professional that gentle movement is not suitable for them. Students who are pregnant, recovering from surgery, or managing specific health concerns are encouraged to let the teacher know before class so appropriate modifications can be offered.

name: Om Chanting
tagline: The transformational power of Om to activate self-healing
description: The class is a group practice from the Babaji lineage that uses the transformational power of om to activate the self-healing potential of participants. Bathing in its resonance clears mental and physical blockages, promotes inner peace, mental clarity, emotional freedom and physical health as the chanting generates a vibrational frequency that releases negativity, transforms it and showers participants with positive energy. The vibrational waves created by the OM Chanting practice continue to resonate in participants bodies after the circle allowing them to share the good vibrations wherever they go.
benefits: Benefits: - Nervous System Regulation: The vibration of OM lengthens exhalation, activates the vagus nerve, and settles the sympathetic “fight–flight” response. This brings calm, reduces anxiety, and stabilizes emotional reactivity. - Energetic Alignment: OM resonates through the whole body, especially crown, throat, and heart, creating coherence between subtle energy centers. Many traditions hold it as the primordial sound, so chanting it re-tunes your field to that baseline frequency. - Expanded Awareness: The sound naturally draws attention inward, quiets the mental field, and anchors awareness in presence. Over time, this dissolves identification with thought and allows direct experience of unity or inner spaciousness.
avoid: Who should avoid this class: People with acute psychosis, schizophrenia, or severe dissociation should avoid regular chanting. They may find the sound resonance destabilizing, as it can amplify inner voices or intensify altered states

name: Singing Bowls
tagline: Connect with your higher self and divine light through sound
description: Singing bowl therapy connects you with your higher self and divine light through sound, you will be able to work through your fears, grievances and unrealized requests, we will immerse ourselves in deep meditation and be able to find answers to all the questions that are hidden within us.
benefits: Benefits: - Deep Inner Healing – The vibrations of the singing bowls help release fears, emotional blockages, and unspoken grievances, creating space for peace and clarity within. - Spiritual Connection – The sound therapy guides you into deep meditation, allowing you to connect with your higher self and divine light, opening a path to inner wisdom and guidance. - Clarity & Self-Discovery – Through the meditative sound journey, hidden questions and unresolved desires naturally surface, helping you find meaningful answers and greater self-understanding.
avoid: Who Should Avoid This Class: Not recommended for individuals currently experiencing acute psychiatric episodes or those on antipsychotic medications, unless advised by a healthcare provider.

name: Heading Back Home
tagline: A journey through yoga and Ayurveda
description: The only safe place is your true self. Sometimes in life, we feel lost, unrooted, alone, or even homeless within ourselves. We may search for balance in the outside world, but the journey is not about becoming someone else. It is about finding our way back home — to who we truly are. In Ayurveda, the five elements (Pancha Mahabhutas) offer a framework for understanding the qualities of nature within our body and mind. Through asanas (yoga postures), pranayama (breathwork), mudras (hand gestures), and a little Brazilian music, we will explore and connect with the five elements — Space, Air, Fire, Water, and Earth — within our body, mind, and spirit.
benefits: Benefits: This practice invites greater self-awareness, openness to intuition, deep relaxation, and a connection with the qualities of each element. Space: Expansion, connection with the sacred, and a sense of openness. Air: Creativity, freedom, lightness, and movement. Fire: Personal power, courage, confidence, and transformation. Water: Flexibility, adaptability, and the ability to feel and express emotions. Earth: Grounding, relaxation, calmness, stability, confidence, and improved sleep.
avoid: Who should avoid: This practice is accessible to most people, including beginners. However, it may not be suitable for everyone. It is not recommended for pregnant women, people recovering from surgery, individuals experiencing acute psychiatric episodes, or those taking antipsychotic medication. If you have another health concerns please let the teacher know.

name: Sensual Healing Dance
tagline: An immersive journey honouring the sacral chakra
description: This class is a full immersive experience journey to honour hidden part of yourself located in your sacral chakra. Reconnect to your body and emotions throughout orgasmic sound, skin and your senses. Creativity in your move to freely let go anchored feelings, trauma and intense emotions. Eya brings you to a safe and sacred space to be heard, seen and express yourself. Express your sensual-self with the heart-open and a connection to pleasure and creativity while moving. Your own being, body essence and vulnerabilities are all embraced. Listen to the music, enjoy your body flow and vibrate your inner child on the floor, while standing up and in the air. No prior experience required. This is an invitation to connect with your body, your sensual-self and whom you truly are. No expectations, just be yourself
benefits: Benefits: - Body and emotions: Connect back to your own body, including energy levels, emotions, self-expression, how to align and ground yourself. - Presence and communication: Learn to communicate needs, desires, and boundaries effectively and respectfully. Being with what is. - Self-respect and empowerment: Develop a positive self-image, a sense of self-worth, and confidence in one's own sensuality.
avoid: Who Should Avoid This Class: This class respects your own rhythm and feelings. Eya has a long-standing experience handling traumatic experience in connection with body and emotions. All releases and authentic reactions are more than welcome. Everyone can attend the class even injured. Loose and comfortable clothes with which you might play are required.

name: Rooted Balance Flow
tagline: A mindful Vinyasa flow
description: A mindful Vinyasa flow that combines steady movement, breath, and balance. This all-level class helps you build stability and body awareness while moving through a balanced sequence of poses.
benefits: Benefits: - Improve balance and stability - Build strength and body awareness - Develop mindful movement and better connection with the breath
avoid: Who should avoid this class: This class may not be suitable for anyone with a recent injury or serious medical condition, or anyone who has been advised by a healthcare professional to avoid physical exercise.

name: Ikigai — Find Your Life Purpose
tagline: A path to clarity and meaningful work
description: A guided journey into identity and alignment. In this class, we explore the Japanese philosophy of Ikigai — your “reason for being” — and reflect on what truly feels authentic in your work and life. Through guided self-inquiry, structured reflection, and a short future-vision exercise, you will reconnect with your inner direction and explore what alignment truly means beyond societal expectations. This is not about quick answers. It is about remembering who you are — and what feels true.
benefits: Benefits: - Gain clarity on what currently feels misaligned in your life or work - Reconnect with your natural strengths and inner compass - Experience a guided future-self visualization to explore your deeper direction
avoid: Who Should Avoid This Class: - This class is not a physical yoga practice, nor a purely theoretical lecture. - It is not about quick motivation. -It is designed for those who are open to honest self-reflection and inner exploration.

name: Tantric Connection & Shamanic Drum Journey
tagline: Reconnect with your heart and journey beyond the mind
description: This class is an invitation to slow down, open your heart and reconnect with the deeper layers of yourself and others. Through conscious connection, presence, shamanic drum and song, you will be gently guided from the outer world into your inner landscape, a space where intuition, inner vision and the wisdom of the heart can unfold. We begin by meeting each other in presence, before turning inward and allowing the rhythm of the drum to carry you on an inner journey. There is nothing you need to achieve or understand. Simply allow yourself to feel, listen, receive and be. As you soften and open, you may experience a deeper connection with your own heart, your intuition and the subtle world beyond the thinking mind. You may encounter images, sensations, emotions or insights, or simply rest in a profound sense of stillness and presence. This is an invitation to step beyond the familiar, to listen to what lives beneath the surface and to explore the space where body, heart, intuition and spirit meet.
benefits: Benefits: - Strengthens your intuition by creating space to listen to your inner knowing and explore your inner vision. - Enhanses the feeling of compassion, connection and a deeper sense of love to yourself and others. - Opens up for healing, deep relaxation and presence
avoid: Who should avoid this class: Not recommended for people living with epilepsy, experiencing an acute psychiatric episode, or taking antipsychotic medication, unless approved by a healthcare provider.

name: The Freedom Hacking Method
tagline: Four hacks with four stories, from monk to philanthropist
description: Join me for a transformative story telling journey (+ Q&A and at least 1 Practical Exercise) as I share the transformative life lessons I’ve gained over the past 25 years — from the struggles of being a bullied kid, the chaos of a teen drug dealer’s life, to the peace and wisdom of a meditation monk and now conscious entrepreneur and philanthropist. Discover how these experiences can empower your own individual and your teams path to success and happiness.
benefits: Benefits: - Presence in Every Moment and Every Area of Life – Learn to access deep presence not only in meditation, but in health, love, money, spirituality, and every situation you face. - Authenticity & Self-Trust – Strengthen your ability to listen to yourself, be true to what you feel, and act from your inner guidance rather than outside pressure. - Comfort in Discomfort – Train to remain empowered, safe, and free even when discomfort arises — transforming challenges into gateways to deeper peace, purpose, and joy.
avoid: Who Should Avoid This Class: Not recommended if you don't want to feel challenged.

name: From Yoga to Ecstatic Dance
tagline: An embodied journey through breath, awareness and movement
description: This class is an invitation to reconnect with yourself through your body, your breath and your inner rhythm. We begin with mindful breathing (pranayama), meditation and yoga asanas, gradually awakening body awareness and exploring the connection between the physical and subtle dimensions of our being. Through a gentle and conscious body preparation, we allow the practice to naturally unfold into fluid, intuitive movement. From grounded yoga to more expressive and spontaneous ways of moving, you are invited to listen to your body, follow its impulses and discover the freedom of movement. Some sessions may gradually open into a guided free-movement or ecstatic dance experience, accompanied by music, creating space for deeper expression and connection. This is an opportunity to release tension, cultivate presence, explore your own expression and reconnect with the joy of being fully alive in your body. Each session is a unique journey into movement, awareness and inner freedom, inviting you to explore, feel and simply be.
benefits: Benefits: - Deepen Body Awareness & Presence: Develop a deeper connection with your body and breath, cultivate mindfulness and feel more present in the moment. - Release Tension & Restore Inner Balance: Release physical and emotional tension through conscious breathing, yoga and fluid movement, inviting greater ease and balance. - Embrace Self-Expression & Inner Freedom: Explore intuitive movement, reconnect with your natural rhythm and open up to a deeper sense of joy, freedom and authentic expression.
avoid: Who Should Avoid This Class: This practice may not be suitable for individuals with acute injuries, significant physical limitations, or medical conditions that could be aggravated by yoga, breathwork or free movement. Those with cardiovascular conditions, uncontrolled high blood pressure, or who are pregnant should consult their healthcare provider before participating. Please always listen to your body, respect your limits and move at your own pace.

name: Conscious Relationship
tagline: Why we struggle in love — and how awareness changes everything
description: Why do we struggle with the people we love most? In this open, guided class, we’ll explore the expectations, emotional reactions, and unconscious patterns that shape our closest relationships. Through shared experiences and honest reflection, we’ll look at what changes when we stop trying to fix one another and begin to see ourselves more clearly through the mirror of love.
benefits: Benefits: - Discover what true love really is — Understand the difference between romantic or emotional love and the deeper recognition of love that already exists within us. - Understand the foundations of a conscious relationship — Explore recognition, self-love, honoring who you are, and allowing another person the freedom to be themselves. - See relationships as a mirror — Discover what your expectations, reactions, and struggles reveal about you, and how this understanding can transform the way you love.
avoid: Who Should Avoid This Class: Not recommended for individuals currently experiencing acute psychiatric episodes or those on antipsychotic medications, unless advised by a healthcare provider.

name: The Ancestral Womb
tagline: A lineage of creation
description: A transmission born from a feminine gift passed down through my lineage. This class awakens the creative power of the womb and the wisdom of the women who came before you. Through breath, movement, and intention, you’ll reconnect with your roots and remember how to create from the deepest source — your womb.
benefits: Benefits: – Reconnection with the creative and intuitive power of the womb, transforming pain into embodied power – Healing of ancestral imprints and emotional blockages stored in the feminine body – Awakening of inner wisdom, self-worth, and creative flow
avoid: Who Should Avoid This Class: – Individuals who are pregnant – Those recovering from recent pelvic or abdominal surgery – Anyone experiencing severe emotional instability or trauma not yet supported in a therapeutic space

name: Breath-Work
tagline: Feel alive again
description: This guided breathwork journey helps you reconnect with your body, release emotional blockages, and awaken your natural creative flow. Through conscious breathing, sound, and gentle guidance, you’ll return to a state of presence where peace and inspiration meet. Each session is an invitation to feel more alive, grounded, and in tune with your inner world.
benefits: Benefits: - Release emotional tension and stress stored in the body - Increase oxygen flow and boost energy levels - Calm the nervous system and enhance clarity - Awaken creativity and intuition - Strengthen the connection between body, heart, and mind
avoid: Who Should Avoid This Class: Breathwork can be intense for some individuals. Please avoid this session if you are pregnant, have cardiovascular issues, epilepsy, glaucoma, high blood pressure, or any severe psychiatric condition. Always consult your doctor before joining if you have medical concerns.

name: Yin — Surrender & Soften
tagline: Slow down, soften and turn inward
description: A gentle & nourishing Yin practice inviting you to slow down, soften and turn inward. Through long-held postures, mindful breathing and stillness, we create space in the body, quiet the mind and reconnect with ourselves.
benefits: Benefits: - Deep relaxation & nervous system regulation - Supports flexibility & mobility - Cultivates mindfulness, presence, stillness & connection to self
avoid: Who Should Avoid the Class: Yin is an accessible practice for everyone, with variations available to support different bodies and needs. If you have an injury, chronic illness or are pregnant, please let me know before class so I can offer appropriate variations and adaptations for your practice.

name: Kundalini Yoga & Crystal Sound Healing
tagline: Kundalini yoga, sacred mantra and crystal bowl sound healing
description: Step into a session combining the ancient technology of Kundalini Yoga, sacred mantra, and crystal bowl sound healing. Through breathwork, movement, and chanting, you’ll activate your energy, clear emotional blocks, and reconnect with your inner power. The class closes with a crystal bowl sound journey to integrate the practice, soothe the nervous system, and bring you into a state of deep inner stillness. This experience is designed to uplift, align, and awaken you—body, mind, and soul. No experience needed—just an open heart and willingness to shift.
benefits: Benefits: - Leave feeling lighter, calmer, and more present. - Ease the stress and anxiety you have been carrying. - Sleep deeper, feel more connected, and come back to joy.
avoid: Who Should Avoid this Class: Not recommended for individuals currently experiencing acute psychiatric episodes or those on antipsychotic medications, unless advised by a healthcare provider.

name: Ancestral Healing
tagline: A Family Constellations experience
description: What if our ancestors offer us more than unresolved burdens to heal? Through experiential exercises and constellation work, this workshop explores the strengths, wisdom, resilience, and life force that have been passed through generations. Participants will be invited to reconnect with ancestral resources and discover what becomes possible when we receive the gifts that support us from behind. The class is for people curious about ancestral healing beyond trauma and inherited burdens, and for those seeking a deeper connection to the strengths, wisdom, and resilience carried through their family lineage.
benefits: Benefits: - Deepen your sense of belonging - Reconnect with sources of strength and support - Expand your perspective on ancestral healing.
avoid: Who Should Avoid This Class: Not recommended for individuals currently experiencing acute psychiatric episodes or those on antipsychotic medications, unless advised by a healthcare provider.

name: Nervous System Rewire Through Somatic Shaking
tagline: Your body already has the blueprint
description: Stop overthinking your healing. Your body already has the blueprint. You’ve spent years analyzing the "why." You’ve done the talk therapy, the journaling, and the mindset work. Yet, the tension remains, a physical weight in your chest, a tightness in your jaw, an unshakable buzz of anxiety in your limbs. This practice uses two types of somatic shaking: Dynamic Shaking, where you intentionally move your body to release tension and anxiety, and Neurogenic Shaking, where the body begins to shake naturally, helping you go deeper and release what’s stored inside. This is a NATURAL mechanism, animals do the same to discharge stress and excess energy, whether after being still for too long or after intense moments like escaping a predator. Your body already knows how to do this.
benefits: Benefits: - release deep muscular and fascial tension stored in the body - calm chronic stress patterns and reduce anxiety - regulate your nervous system and build real resilience - support circulation and stimulate lymphatic flow - access and release emotional charge without reliving the story - reconnect with a grounded sense of safety and presence in your body
avoid: Who Should Avoid This Class: Not recommended for individuals currently experiencing acute psychiatric episodes or those on antipsychotic medications, unless advised by a healthcare provider.

name: Kundalini Dance
tagline: An alchemical dance journey through the seven chakras, with a live DJ set
description: An immersive journey into movement, self-expression and connection with your body. Inspired by the Five Elements — Water, Wood, Fire, Earth and Metal — this experience guides you through different qualities of movement, from fluidity and exploration to expression, grounding and stillness. Through music, gentle guidance and free-form dance, you are invited to release tension, explore your emotions and reconnect with your natural rhythm. Accompanied by a live DJ set, there is no choreography or right way to move — simply an invitation to follow what feels alive within you. Your body, your pace, your experience.
benefits: Benefits: - Deepen body awareness and connection. - Release tension and explore emotional expression. - Cultivate presence, grounding and inner freedom - Discover new ways of moving and expressing yourself. - Experience connection through collective movement.
avoid: Who should avoid this class: Open to everyone, regardless of age, fitness level or dance experience, as long as you are able to participate in movement. You are welcome to adapt the range, intensity and body parts involved in your movement according to your abilities and comfort. Move gently, take breaks and honour your own boundaries. There is no expectation to perform or keep up with others.

name: Cooking Class — Dadar Gulung
tagline: The Indonesian coconut pancake
description: Dadar Gulung is a traditional Indonesian sweet pancake, famous for its soft, thin, green pandan-flavoured crepe filled with sweet grated coconut. The filling is made from freshly grated coconut cooked with palm sugar, creating a delicious combination of sweetness and rich coconut aroma. Its vibrant green colour comes from pandan leaves, giving the pancake a naturally fragrant flavour. Dadar Gulung is a popular traditional Indonesian snack, often enjoyed as a dessert or afternoon treat.
avoid: Who should avoid eating: - Coconut allergy: People with a coconut allergy should avoid this food because both the filling and sometimes the pancake contain coconut or coconut-derived ingredients. - Egg allergy - Gluten intolerance or wheat allergy - Dairy allergy: Although traditional recipes are usually dairy-free, some variations may contain milk or butter.

name: Joyful Living Yoga
tagline: Laughter yoga — instantly lowers cortisol and calms the nervous system
description: Laughter Yoga (Hasya Yoga) is a wellness practice combining intentional laughter with deep yogic breathing (pranayama). Developed by Dr. Madan Kataria in 1995, it relies on the scientific fact that the body cannot distinguish between real and simulated laughter, delivering the same physical and mental health benefits.
benefits: Benefits: - Stress Reduction: Instantly lowers cortisol levels and calms the nervous system mood - Enhancement: Releases dopamine, serotonin, and endorphins, acting as a natural antidepressant. - Resilience & Focus: Increases oxygen to the brain, which enhances mental clarity and cognitive performance.
avoid: Who should avoid this class: - Advanced (bleeding) piles - Any kind of hernia - Any persistent cough - Anything with acute symptoms - Epilepsy - Heart disease - High blood pressure - Incontinence of urine - Major psychiatric disorders - Severe backache - Having undergone surgery within the last 3 months - First or third trimester of pregnancy, and before 8 weeks after birth

name: Kundalini Yoga for the 7 Chakras
tagline: Asanas, meditation, pranayam and mantra
description: A class with a mix of asanas, meditation, pranayam and mantra to awaken the energy flow through the main chakras.
benefits: Benefits: - Awaken your energy system - Establish the energy flow - Get in touch with your energy field
avoid: Who should avoid this class: If you are early or late in a pregnancy, it's best to avoid.

name: Survival to Soul
tagline: Kundalini activation and quantum energy healing
description: A safe space to surrender, release and reconnect with the deepest parts of yourself. Throughout life, we accumulate layers of conditioning, emotional experiences, limiting beliefs and patterns that can disconnect us from our natural state of presence, love and abundance. Through an energy transmission combining Kundalini Activation and Quantum Energy Healing, you are invited to move beyond the mind, soften into the body and reconnect with your innate life force energy. As you surrender into the experience, you may notice emotional release, energetic movement, deep relaxation, shifts in awareness or a profound sense of connection with yourself. There is nothing you need to achieve or force. Simply come as you are, lie down, close your eyes and allow yourself to receive. A beautiful opportunity to release what you have been carrying, reconnect with your inner essence and remember the freedom of simply being.
benefits: Benefits: - Release & emotional integration: beginning to let go of suppressed emotions, layers of conditioning and limiting beliefs. - Reconnect with yourself - Move beyond the mind and experience deeper presence, inner connection and awareness. - Awaken your life force energy - Activate your innate energetic potential, reconnect with your inner power and open yourself to deeper states of consciousness and connection.
avoid: Who should avoid the class: Anyone with heart problems or pace maker it is not recommended to attend. Also anyone who is pregnant.

name: Breathwork — A Journey Back to Yourself
tagline: A 75-minute experiential breathwork journey
description: A 75-minute experiential journey using the breath as a doorway into deeper presence, emotional release, vitality and connection with yourself. Each session begins by arriving into the body through conscious movement and a short opening circle, followed by a guided breathwork journey and a period of integration and sharing. The practice may vary from week to week. Some journeys can be more activating, expressive and cathartic, while others may be slower, softer and more inward-focused, exploring different breathing rhythms and approaches. Rather than following one fixed technique, each class becomes an invitation to meet yourself exactly where you are, to breathe, feel, release, listen and reconnect. No previous breathwork experience is required. Come as you are, breathe with what is present, and allow the journey to unfold
benefits: Benefits: - Become more present - Have more clarity - Feeling more at home in your body
avoid: Who Should Avoid this Class: Not recommended for individuals currently experiencing acute psychiatric episodes or those on antipsychotic medications, unless advised by a healthcare provider.

name: Power Yoga
tagline: A dynamic, Vinyasa-style yoga practice
description: Power Yoga is a dynamic, fitness-based style of yoga that combines strength, flexibility, and stamina into a vigorous, flowing practice. Power Yoga emphasizes breath-synchronized movement and builds internal heat, making it both a physical workout and a mental reset. In this class, expect a strong, energetic sequence that challenges the body, sharpens focus, and leaves you feeling empowered and revitalized.
benefits: Benefits: - Builds Strength & Endurance – Engages major muscle groups and boosts cardiovascular fitness through continuous movement. - Enhances Mental Focus – Encourages presence and discipline through breathwork and challenging transitions. - Detoxifies the Body – Generates internal heat to promote sweat and support detoxification.
avoid: Who should avoid this class: - Recent surgeries or acute injuries (especially wrists, shoulders, or knees) - Uncontrolled high blood pressure or heart conditions - Pregnancy

name: Tantric Meditation
tagline: Presence, mantra, breath and moments for inner inquiry
description: Tantric Meditation is an exploration of presence and consciousness rooted in the wisdom of Non-Dual Shaivism. Rather than escaping the world to reach a state of bliss, we learn to meet life as it unfolds, discovering awareness through our direct experience of each moment. Through meditation, somatic movement, breathwork, the chanting of sacred mantras, and practices of deity invocation and contemplation, we explore the body as a doorway to presence and connect with the divine energies that permeate existence.
benefits: Benefits: - Cultivate greater presence and awareness in everyday life. - Explore consciousness through the wisdom of Tantra. - Experience the transformative practice of mantra chanting and sacred sound. - Connect with Tantric deities and embody their qualities and energies. - Deepen your connection to the body, breath, and the sacred within everyday life.
avoid: Who Should Avoid This Class: This class is open to everyone, regardless of experience or religious background. No previous knowledge of Tantra is required. All practices can be adapted to your needs, and movement and breathwork are always optional.

name: Astrology & Archetypes
tagline: A meditative journey through creation
description: Astrology is a map of the cosmos within us, reflecting universal archetypes that shape our lives and experiences. In this class, we will explore how these archetypes were created, how they move through energy and synchronicity, and how they manifest in our personal astrology. We will dive into Explore the concept of creation, energy, and synchronicity, The astrological archetypes and their connection to creation and the elements, How archetypes express themselves in our natal charts and life experiences, Engage in reflective discussion and personal exploration. No prior astrology knowledge is required—just an open heart and cosmic curiosity.
benefits: Benefits: - Practical Application of Astrology – Explore how astrology can serve as a tool for self-awareness and spiritual growth. - Foundational Knowledge – Gain a clear understanding of the zodiac signs, their elemental qualities, and modalities. - Archetypal Connection – Engage with the symbolic and mythological dimensions of astrology through guided meditative practices.
avoid: Who Should Avoid This Class: This class is rooted in the Western (tropical) astrological tradition. It may not be suitable for individuals who do not have an openness to astrology as a framework for learning and reflection.

name: Conscious Conversations — NOMOS: Are We Aligned?
tagline: A free NOMOS compatibility experience in Ubud
description: A Free NOMOS Compatibility Experience in Ubud Discover what really happens when your energy meets someone else’s. NOMOS Cross is a birth-date based system that maps your natural energetic pattern and reveals how two people align in relationship. It works with the natural 13:20 timing principle, rather than the conventional 12:60 structure of clock time. Bring your partner, your date, your crush, a friend, an ex, or simply the birth date of someone you want to understand better. You will discover: - How naturally you align - What creates attraction between you - Where tension and misunderstandings can appear - What each person brings into the relationship - How your differences can complement each other - Your NOMOS compatibility pattern Why come? Because chemistry can tell you that something is happening. NOMOS helps you see the pattern behind it. No previous knowledge is needed, and you do not need to come with the other person. Bring two birth dates and discover the connection between them.

tagline: Slow down, soften and turn inward
description: A gentle & nourishing Yin practice inviting you to slow down, soften and turn inward. Through long-held postures, mindful breathing and stillness, we create space in the body, quiet the mind and reconnect with ourselves.
benefits: Benefits: - Deep relaxation & nervous system regulation - Supports flexibility & mobility - Cultivates mindfulness, presence, stillness & connection to self
avoid: Who Should Avoid the Class: Yin is an accessible practice for everyone, with variations available to support different bodies and needs. If you have an injury, chronic illness or are pregnant, please let me know before class so I can offer appropriate variations and adaptations for your practice.

tagline: Asanas, meditation, pranayam and mantra
description: A class with a mix of asanas, meditation, pranayam and mantra to awaken the energy flow through the main chakras.
benefits: Benefits: - Awaken your energy system - Establish the energy flow - Get in touch with your energy field
avoid: Who should avoid this class: If you are early or late in a pregnancy, it's best to avoid.

name: A Somatic Journey
tagline: Coming home to the living body
description: This is a space to pause exhale, and connect to yourself - not as an idea of who you are, but as a living, breathing, sensing body. Through simple yet powerful somatic practice – alone, in pairs, and in the group – we explore boundaries, presence, and the quiet language of touch. Each session is a gentle invitation to feel, to relate, and to come closer - to yourself and to another. In these sessions, we learn to notice the signals of the body and listen to them with care, explore where our boundaries are and how we feel contact with another, awaken sensitivity to hear our inner "yes" and "no", gently release the tensions and blocks that make it hard to live, move, and feel, attune to a kind of connection where we don't lose ourselves, but stay rooted within. No previous experience is needed.
benefits: Benefits: - Authentic Expression – Encourages movement from inner impulse and invites students to experience themselves as living, changing beings — not as a fixed idea of “who I am.” - Release & Renewal – Releases stress and tension held from unexpressed emotions or past trauma, allowing unfinished feelings to be completed and the nervous system to return to its natural balance. - Relational Awareness – Developing awareness of your needs and boundaries, while exploring trust, the ability to both give and receive support, and the skills of asking, saying no, and taking.
avoid: Who Should Avoid This Class: Recent serious injuries or surgeries. Severe psychiatric conditions where grounding practices may feel destabilizing. If you are pregnant, please let me know in advance so we can adapt the practice safely.

name: Family Constellations
tagline: Explore the deeper layers behind our emotions
description: What if some of the limiting behaviour patterns, blocks, struggles and burdens you experience in your current life are not really about what is happening right now? What if some of these limitations are rooted in memories and experiences from the past that your system still responds to as if they are relevant to your survival today? And what if these old patterns can be reconditioned by bringing them into the present moment, where the old "truths" can meet the reality of who you are now? Family Constellations offers a way to explore the deeper layers behind our emotions, reactions, and recurring patterns. It can help us understand how challenges in our present lives may be connected to dynamics, beliefs, and conditioning from our family of origin, including responsibilities or burdens that may not truly belong to us. By bringing these unconscious patterns into awareness through observation and experience, we can begin to recognize what is no longer relevant to our lives today and explore healthier ways of responding. Rather than only understanding patterns intellectually, the process allows us to experience them through the body, creating space for greater awareness, self-regulation, and personal change. Each Sunday, the class takes a different approach. We may work in pairs or small groups, or explore one participant’s question through a full-group constellation. Through observing and participating, you can discover the deeper relevance of Family Constellations as a practice for healing, personal growth, and self-exploration.
benefits: Benefits: - More confidence, self-love and acceptance of situations - Greater emotional independence and healthier relationships - More focus, empowerment and freedom to create the life you want
avoid: Who should avoid this class: The classes are open to everybody, but you are always asked to take responsibility for yourself. If at any point you feel that something is too much for you, or you feel unexpectedly overwhelmed or too tense on that particular day, you are always free to leave a role or leave the class altogether.

name: Joyful Living Yoga
tagline: Laughter yoga — instantly lowers cortisol and calms the nervous system
description: Laughter Yoga (Hasya Yoga) is a wellness practice combining intentional laughter with deep yogic breathing (pranayama). Developed by Dr. Madan Kataria in 1995, it relies on the scientific fact that the body cannot distinguish between real and simulated laughter, delivering the same physical and mental health benefits.
benefits: Benefits: - Stress Reduction: Instantly lowers cortisol levels and calms the nervous system mood - Enhancement: Releases dopamine, serotonin, and endorphins, acting as a natural antidepressant. - Resilience & Focus: Increases oxygen to the brain, which enhances mental clarity and cognitive performance.
avoid: Who should avoid this class: - Advanced (bleeding) piles - Any kind of hernia - Any persistent cough - Anything with acute symptoms - Epilepsy - Heart disease - High blood pressure - Incontinence of urine - Major psychiatric disorders - Severe backache - Having undergone surgery within the last 3 months - First or third trimester of pregnancy, and before 8 weeks after birth

name: Heading Back Home
tagline: A journey through yoga and Ayurveda
description: The only safe place is your true self. Sometimes in life, we feel lost, unrooted, alone, or even homeless within ourselves. We may search for balance in the outside world, but the journey is not about becoming someone else. It is about finding our way back home — to who we truly are. In Ayurveda, the five elements (Pancha Mahabhutas) offer a framework for understanding the qualities of nature within our body and mind. Through asanas (yoga postures), pranayama (breathwork), mudras (hand gestures), and a little Brazilian music, we will explore and connect with the five elements — Space, Air, Fire, Water, and Earth — within our body, mind, and spirit.
benefits: Benefits: This practice invites greater self-awareness, openness to intuition, deep relaxation, and a connection with the qualities of each element. Space: Expansion, connection with the sacred, and a sense of openness. Air: Creativity, freedom, lightness, and movement. Fire: Personal power, courage, confidence, and transformation. Water: Flexibility, adaptability, and the ability to feel and express emotions. Earth: Grounding, relaxation, calmness, stability, confidence, and improved sleep.
avoid: Who should avoid: This practice is accessible to most people, including beginners. However, it may not be suitable for everyone. It is not recommended for pregnant women, people recovering from surgery, individuals experiencing acute psychiatric episodes, or those taking antipsychotic medication. If you have another health concerns please let the teacher know.
